question: What functional group and vibration mode does Table 3 assign to the CH4 peaks, and at what wavenumbers?
expect: C-H stretching vibration; 3014 cm-1 in air, 3016 cm-1 in nitrogen (Table 3)
rendered:
Table 3: Assignment of Absorption Peaks in FTIR Spectra under Air and Nitrogen Atmospheres

| Absorption Peak (cm^− 1) | Gas Product | Air Atmosphere | Nitrogen Atmosphere | Functional Group | Vibration Mode |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
|  |  |  |  |  |  |
| 3014 | CH4 |  |  | C−H | Stretching vibration |
|  |  |  |  |  |  |
|  |  |  |  |  |  |
| 886,2913 | CnHm |  |  | C−H | Stretching vibration |

The functional group and vibration mode assigned to the CH4 peaks are C−H and stretching vibration, respectively. The wavenumbers are 3014 cm^− 1.
